title: Warm Wholesome Wilted Egyptian Kale Fondue
description: A nostalgic, ovo-vegetarian fondue dish featuring wilted kale and a hint of coconut cream.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.notes: stems removed, leaves torn into 2-inch pieces

instructions: In a large fondue pot or a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the fondue pot, and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the torn kale to the fondue pot, and cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted and tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream, mustard powder, salt, and black pepper.
Continue to heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until the fondue reaches a warm, bubbly consistency.
Add the crumbled feta cheese, if using, and stir until melted and well combined.
Serve the warm, wilted kale fondue with sliced pita bread for dipping.
